i.n: high-grade flour, plus more for kneading

method.s: Dissolve sugar in water. Sprinkle yeast over the top and allow to stand in a warm place for ten minutes.
Mix in flour, oil and salt and combine evenly into a soft dough.
Knead on a very lightly floured surface for five minutes, including throwing the dough, until smooth and a little sticky.
Transfer to a lightly oiled bowl, cover and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in size (around 30 to 40 minutes).
Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, roll into a log shape and cut into four pieces.
Roll into balls and leave to rise for 15 minutes.

Roll out thinly on baking paper, add toppings and bake (still on the baking paper) on a preheated pizza stone or oven tray, at 240 deg C for around 10 to 12 minutes, or until base is crispy and golden.
